scope: Main WIUT production server; connected native Java protocol clients without OP, followed by a clean restart and removal of temporary fixtures.

before_restart.check: Three temporary Java clients connect without OP through the public domain
AuthMe blocks clan commands before authentication
Authenticated ordinary players enter the creative world
Temporary fixture occupies untouched flat terrain
Ordinary owner creates a full-height creative claim
Untrusted outsider cannot place blocks in the claim
Clan creation, invitation and acceptance work for ordinary players
New clan membership immediately grants shared construction
Clan trust grants native chest access
Another clan cannot open the shared chest
Leaving a clan immediately removes build access
Rejoining immediately restores clan access
Exclusion immediately removes clan access
Owner can explicitly share the claim with another selected clan
Revoking selected foreign-clan trust immediately blocks building
Container-only clan trust permits native chest access
Container-only clan trust does not grant construction
Mechanism-only clan trust permits a native lever interaction
Mechanism-only clan trust does not grant construction
Mechanism-only clan trust does not grant chest access
Mechanism-only trust excludes other clans
Revocation immediately removes native lever access
Clan members retain shared access while the owner is offline

after_restart.check: Clan membership survives the clean production restart
Shared clan claim survives the clean production restart
Fresh authenticated sessions regain persisted clan construction rights
Persisted claim still excludes a different clan
Disabled clan feature commands cannot teleport ordinary players
Another connected client receives ordinary chat with the clan tag
Survival inventory and experience remain preserved on production
Survival return preserves the saved location
Clan membership is shared between survival and creative
Creative inventory remains separate from survival
Disbanding immediately revokes persisted claim access
Temporary test claim is removed after verification
Temporary block fixture is restored to air

service_and_configuration_checks.check: Main server is running after the final clean startup
WIUT SimpleClans release loads on the main server
Final startup contains no unexpected runtime errors
Installed JAR matches the tested public release checksum
No observer or test plugin is installed on production
Exactly one active SimpleClans JAR is installed
Existing creative-only claim protection remains unchanged
Existing backups include clan data and LuckPerms permissions
All temporary test identities removed from the whitelist
Creative travel and inventory isolation are ready
End lock, locator policy and survival borders remain active
Analytics, voice page and map return HTTP 200
Persistence and fixture cleanup checks passed

diagnostic_qualifications: Earlier transport and harness attempts were retained privately and are excluded from the passing count.
The harness was corrected for panel timeouts, password length, console echo/ANSI parsing and existing connection/AuthMe admission delays.
The 23 accepted pre-restart checks and 13 post-restart checks form separate recorded stages; an interrupted reconnect does not count as a successful test.
No additional production plugin code changes were required after the published release.
